title: PRMT6-mediated EZH2 arginine methylation is critical for breast cancer development
task: Determine PRMT6-mediated EZH2 methylation mechanism in breast cancer tumorigenesis
key_results: PRMT6 asymmetrically dimethylates EZH2 at R509, enhancing PRC2-induced H3K27 methylation and suppressing target gene expression; dual PRMT6/EZH2 inhibition effectively suppresses xenograft growth
comments: The mechanistic link between R509 methylation, PRC2 complex assembly, and downstream gene silencing is well-supported by both in vitro and in vivo data.

model_io.model: Breast cancer cell lines and mouse xenografts

hypotheses.hypothesis: PRMT6-mediated EZH2 R509 dimethylation promotes PRC2 assembly and H3K27 methylation-dependent transcriptional silencing
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; dual inhibition of PRMT6 and EZH2 synergistically suppresses breast tumor growth

title: Spatiotemporal dynamics and ossification of podoplanin-positive cells in the developing femur
task: Characterize spatiotemporal dynamics and functions of PDPN-positive cells in fetal femur ossification
key_results: PDPN-positive cells emerged in bone collar concurrent with primary ossification center initiation; most exhibited osteolineage features (osterix+); Pdpn knockout caused abnormal osterix+ cell recruitment and impaired mineral deposition
comments: The study elegantly links PDPN expression to osteolineage commitment during endochondral ossification, though specific molecular mechanisms downstream of PDPN remain to be defined.

model_io.model: Fetal mouse femur development and Pdpn knockout mice

hypotheses.hypothesis: PDPN-positive cells constitute a spatially-regulated osteolineage population essential for coordinated fetal femur development
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Pdpn knockout resulted in abnormal osterix+ cell recruitment and defective mineralization

title: Exosomal microRNA-4800-3p in portal vein blood promotes liver metastasis in pancreatic cancer by targeting PLAA
task: Identify exosomal miR-4800-3p in portal vein blood as a promoter of pancreatic cancer liver metastasis
key_results: miR-4800-3p highly expressed in portal vein blood (PVB) but not peripheral blood (PB); targets PLAA to enhance GRCC5A oncogene; miR-4800-3p overexpression increased tumor nodules in vivo; PLAA expression significantly lower in liver vs lung metastases
comments: The use of intraoperative PVB sampling to identify metastasis-specific exosomal signatures is methodologically sound; however, functional validation of the miR-4800-3p→PLAA→GRCC5A axis requires direct protein-level mechanistic studies.

model_io.model: Pancreatic cancer patients (PB/PVB sampling), PC cell lines, and PC liver metastasis xenografts

hypotheses.hypothesis: miR-4800-3p suppresses PLAA, preventing GRCC5A degradation and promoting liver metastatic potential
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; miR-4800-3p overexpression enhanced EMT and increased tumor nodules; PLAA inversely correlated with liver metastasis

title: Harnessing Id1 as a biomarker in a plasmid reporter system for cervical cancer
task: Develop Id1-driven plasmid reporter system for cervical cancer detection
key_results: CC cell lines expressed Id1 3.0-fold higher than fibroblasts (P<0.0001); pId1-SEAP reporter produced SEAP proportional to endogenous Id1; as few as 12,500 transfected HeLa cells generated detectable SEAP (P=0.004)
comments: Demonstrates proof-of-concept for cancer-specific promoter-driven diagnostics; clinical utility requires optimization of transfection efficiency and in vivo validation in patient samples.

model_io.model: CC cell lines (HeLa, SiHa), non-cancer fibroblasts (3T3), and SiHa xenografts

hypotheses.hypothesis: Id1 promoter activity correlates with CC-specific SEAP expression from pId1-SEAP plasmid
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; CC tissues and cells show 10-100 fold higher Id1 staining and proportional SEAP production

title: CQMUH-011 mitigated LPS-induced acute lung injury in neonatal rabbits
task: Evaluate CQMUH-011 protection against LPS-induced acute lung injury in neonates
key_results: CQMUH-011 dose-dependently mitigated neurological deficits, restored blood gas balance, and reduced inflammatory lung injury comparable to dexamethasone; transcriptomic profiling suggested PI3K/AKT-dependent cytoprotection
comments: Therapeutic potential acknowledged as early-stage proof-of-concept; protein-level validation of transcriptomic findings is lacking and needed before clinical translation.

model_io.model: Neonatal rabbit LPS-induced endotoxin shock

hypotheses.hypothesis: CQMUH-011 suppresses inflammatory pathways and modulates PI3K/AKT-dependent cytoprotection
hypotheses.result: Transcriptomic evidence supports pathway downregulation; protein-level confirmation pending

title: Smart beamforming and deep-learning reader for RFID systems in edge IoT
task: Chipless RFID tag decoding using beamforming and deep learning on edge IoT platforms
key_results: Beamforming gain 10–12 dB at broadside; CNN decoder improved whole-code accuracy from ≈0.73 to ≈0.86; bit-wise accuracy improved from ≈0.93 to ≈0.98
comments: Well-integrated co-design of tag physics, beamforming, and deep learning for practical IoT, though performance under extreme environmental variations (e.g., strong multipath) is not thoroughly characterized.

1×4 Tx/Rx beamforming reader with digital beamforming

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deep learning decoder combined with beamforming significantly improves robustness under low-SNR, rotated, and detuned conditions

title: Optimized ANN-based bio-thermodynamic modeling of unsteady flows with coupled nanoparticle–microbial–activation-energy transport in heterogeneous porous media
task: Bio-thermodynamic modeling of unsteady nanofluid-microbial flow with entropy optimization via ANN
key_results: Microbial motility reduced entropy generation by up to 22%; nanoparticle buoyancy decreased wall shear and heat transfer by 15–18%; ANN mapped nonlinear input-output relationships
